pages.text: White salt coated Dad's boat. Dad gave them a water bucket and brushes.
They wanted to wash Dad's boat until it sparkled. "Dad will be surprised when he sees it this evening."
Riri began brushing at the bow. Lolo lifted the water bucket high. "We should clean it in order." "Pour water first."
Riri scrubbed one spot hard. An area the size of her palm sparkled.
The sun sank. The sparkling spot was still only a handspan wide.
Lolo splashed water over the boat. Bubbles foamed and spilled.
Lolo slipped on the foam and landed with a thump!
The sky darkened, and a sudden shower poured down. They ran under the eaves of the pier warehouse.
The rain stopped. The boat had been rinsed clean from top to bottom.
Dad arrived and stared at the boat. "We washed it!" They puffed out their chests. Just then, thunder rumbled in the sky.
